source.upstream: references/styles/01_通用母版/极简排版/宣言备忘录风.md

visual_language.direction: all-text memo deck, pure white or black field with reading-grade typography, one assertion or prose block per page, single accent color highlighting only key phrases, zero images zero bullets, hand-typeset document dignity

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以阅读级排印、一页一观点与唯一强调色金句高亮的纯文字纪律,做文化宣言与深度备忘录;零图零 bullet,纯文字是 HTML 最稳的还原
legacy_payload.visual_direction: all-text memo deck, pure white or black field with reading-grade typography, one assertion or prose block per page, single accent color highlighting only key phrases, zero images zero bullets, hand-typeset document dignity

canvas.background: 纯白文档场 #FFFFFF(纯黑宣言变体允许,行为不变)
canvas.composition: 一页一观点:金句断言大字左对齐层级,或一段散文(max-width 控制行宽);附录用极简 table
canvas.density: low-to-medium,散文体而非 bullet;行宽 65ch 级阅读舒适

color_palette.accent: #E50914(唯一强调色,示例 Netflix 红;金句关键短语专用)
color_palette.rule: 底黑字白或底白字黑二元;强调色只做 span 高亮关键短语(<5% 面积);零图片零图标零装饰

typography.title: 金句断言:Archivo 超粗 / 思源黑体 Heavy 左对齐,或衬线宣言体(Newsreader / 思源宋体)按气质二选一
typography.body: 阅读级排印(Newsreader / Source Serif / 思源宋体),行宽控制,散文段落
typography.labels: 页眉页脚与日期用灰级小字;制度名词可全大写 span 高亮

layout_patterns: 金句页 = 满版底 + 一句断言大字(关键短语强调色高亮)
散文页 = 一段口语化坦诚文字,65ch 行宽,无 bullet 无图
制度页 = 制度名词高亮(如 Keeper Test)+ 一两行解释
附录页 = 极简 table(数据/对照),细线表 + 小字注
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 一页一观点,零图零 bullet:强调色只高亮关键短语;口语化坦诚,像内部备忘录不像发布会
negative_prompt: no images, icons or decorative shapes — words only
no bullet lists; prose and assertions carry the argument
no multi-color highlights; one accent color on key phrases
no dense walls of small text; one idea per page at reading scale

visual_elements.allowed: 金句断言,散文段,唯一强调色 span,极简 table,灰级页眉页脚
visual_elements.avoid: 图片;图标;bullet;多彩高亮;装饰形状

rendering_constraints: Pure typography: assertions at clamp-scale, prose at 65ch measure.
Single accent color on key phrases only.
legacy_payload.reference: GitHub: huashu-design · design-styles.md PPT 库「纯文字宣言备忘录」

recommendation_features.feature_defaults_basis: family-prior (U3)：机械默认按家族语义先验替换，来源记录在案

negative: Pure typography: assertions at clamp-scale, prose at 65ch measure.
